propositions: The rebar metrics command must parse --since and --until date-range arguments and --output format flag (json or text)
The metrics command must render the full MetricSpec registry over the specified date range, calling evaluate() for each spec with a context object containing repo_root, since, and until
The metrics command must be dispatched via an explicit if sub == 'metrics' arm in _dispatch() on the reads path (mirroring init/scratch/delete/fsck), not via frozenset membership
The metrics.py module must import rebar.metrics package (not just registry) to trigger registry hydration via reader module side-effects, and must NOT import rebar.metrics.adapters modules
The render loop must catch exceptions from individual metric compute() calls and render those metrics as unavailable with an error reason, rather than failing the entire command

JSON output must include since/until fields and a metrics map with every registered id, each containing lens+source+confidence+value or unavailable+reason; text output must list each id with its lens, source, and value-or-unavailable on one line per metric
